subject: Re: Partnership request — joint hands-on webinar on inference at scale
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@schematics.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint hands-on webinar: 'Inference at Scale' — interest?

Hi Ben,

Quick intro — I’m Elena (Head of Partnerships at Schematics AI). We’re seeing a lot of customer interest in production inference patterns and thought a short, joint hands-on webinar with Redwood’s serving/runtime team would be really valuable. High-level idea: a 60-minute session — 10m intros, 20m live demo (Schematics + Redwood integration), 15m partner case study, 15m live Q&A.

Proposed time windows: week of June 22 or July 6 (US-friendly). We can handle registration and follow-up cadence if Redwood will co-promote and provide a 1-page one-pager for the registration page.

Can you put me in touch with whoever owns partner webinars on your side? We’d like to surface 2 speakers (one product, one customer) and share a short promo kit.

Thanks — happy to hop on 15m if that’s easier.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Partnerships, Schematics AI
[Attachment: schematics_partnership_onepager.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint hands-on webinar: 'Inference at Scale' — interest?

Hi Elena — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for reaching out — we’re very interested. The format you propose sounds spot on.

High level next steps from Redwood: 1) Confirm date and time (we prefer June 24 or July 8 in those windows), 2) exchange speaker names/bios/logos, 3) lock down a draft agenda + registration copy, 4) do an AV run-through a week prior. I’ve attached a short one-pager we usually hand to registrants so you can see our suggested language.

Two quick asks: can Schematics share standard sponsor/partner guidelines (logo sizes, preferred blurbs) and confirm whether you expect a sponsor fee or paid promotions?

Looping in Marissa (alliance marketing) and Jonas (field ops) to help with promo and logistics.

Cheers,
Ben
Senior Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_webinar_onepager.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks Ben — hi Elena. I’m Marissa on the alliances/marketing side — happy to run promo. I put together a short promo template and a speaker-bio template to speed things up.

What we need from Schematics this week if you want the registration to go live next Monday:
- Preferred date (June 24 / July 8)
- Speaker names, titles, 2-sentence bios, and headshots
- Company logo (SVG + PNG) and preferred short blurb (25–40 words)
- Any customer permission for the case study segment (name/company + contact)

Draft promo blurb (please edit): "Join Redwood Inference and Schematics AI for a hands-on webinar on deploying inference at scale. Learn practical patterns for low-latency serving, caching strategies, and a live integration demo."

Attaching promo templates and a week-by-week promo cadence (we usually run 2 weeks of email + social). I’ll also create the HubSpot event and share the link once you confirm.

Thanks — happy to take a 15m sync if helpful.

Attachments: promo_bio_template.docx, promo_schedule_v1.xlsx

—Marissa
